hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) pnpm exec eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; } || true
